products.title: Eggplant
products.short_description: An eggplant outline decal with plenty of attitude.
products.full_description: A clean, unmistakable eggplant silhouette with a leaf-shaped stem. Choose a size and make it yours in standard vinyl, specialty finishes, or the purple-and-green multicolor version.

products.title: Fuck You (Knewave)
products.short_description: A bold FUCK YOU decal in chunky Knewave lettering.
products.full_description: No fine print, no mixed signals. This cut-vinyl decal spells out FUCK YOU in thick, playful Knewave-style letters and comes in multiple photographed sizes.

products.title: Censored Eat Shit (Long)
products.short_description: An elongated EAT SHIT decal with a poop symbol in the lettering.
products.full_description: A long, narrow cut-vinyl design that spells out EAT SHIT, with a poop icon taking the place of a letter. Made for anyone who prefers their insults with a tiny visual punchline.

products.title: Love Tucson
products.short_description: An Arizona-outline decal with a tiny poop and heart.
products.full_description: An outline of Arizona with a little poop symbol and a heart inside. A proudly irreverent way to show love for Tucson, photographed in pink, black, and purple vinyl.

products.title: Cunt
products.short_description: The word CUNT in oversized block lettering.
products.full_description: Four big letters and absolutely no attempt to soften them. This cut-vinyl decal uses straight, bold block lettering, with white and pink versions pictured.

products.title: Cat Heart Poop
products.short_description: A line-art cat, heart, paw, and poop symbol sequence.
products.full_description: A playful row of four outlined symbols: a cat, a heart, a paw print, and a poop pile. One little visual sentence for people who adore their cats and know what comes with them.

products.title: Dog Heart Poop
products.short_description: A line-art dog, heart, paw, and poop symbol sequence.
products.full_description: Four minimal outlined symbols combine a dog, a heart, a paw print, and a poop pile. A compact design that says a lot about life with a dog without needing words.

products.title: Bird Poop Trail
products.short_description: A bird outline followed by a trail of tiny poop symbols.
products.full_description: A simple pigeon-like bird silhouette, with several little poop icons trailing behind it. A lighthearted reminder of what birds leave in their wake.

products.title: Cat Poop Trail
products.short_description: A cat outline with a trail of little poop symbols.
products.full_description: A mischievous line-art cat followed by a neat line of tiny poop piles. It's the less glamorous side of cat ownership, rendered as one very direct decal.

products.title: My Cat Thinks You Suck
products.short_description: Cat ears and eyes above the phrase MY CAT THINKS YOU SUCK.
products.full_description: The judgmental stare says it first. Cat ears and sharply drawn eyes sit above the words MY CAT THINKS YOU SUCK in a deliberately cheeky cut-vinyl design.
products.image_alt_text: My Cat Thinks You Suck cut-vinyl decal

products.title: Eat Shit (Stacked)
products.short_description: EAT SHIT lettering arranged in two stacked lines.
products.full_description: Two short words, stacked for maximum impact. The plain-text EAT SHIT decal has simple lowercase lettering and is pictured in purple and white versions.

products.title: Emoji Eat Shit
products.short_description: A holographic visual pun made from eating utensils and a poop emoji.
products.full_description: A fork, plate, and knife sit beside a poop symbol to turn EAT SHIT into a pictogram. The photographed holographic silver version flashes different colors as it catches the light.

products.title: Bitch (Script)
products.short_description: BITCH in sweeping cursive lettering.
products.full_description: A flowing handwritten-style Bitch decal with a long, dramatic underline. The photographed version uses purple vinyl, giving a sharp word a surprisingly elegant treatment.

products.title: Emoji Peach
products.short_description: A simple peach outline with a pointed leaf.
products.full_description: A bold, clean outline of a peach with a little leaf on top. It works as a fruit, an emoji, or whatever else you decide it's saying.

products.title: Fuck Off
products.short_description: FUCK OFF in large, straightforward block lettering.
products.full_description: A no-nonsense cut-vinyl FUCK OFF text decal with widely spaced block capitals. The photographed versions show white and red vinyl in different sizes.

products.title: Poopin Guy
products.short_description: A squatting stick figure with a poop pile.
products.full_description: The familiar restroom-style pictogram takes a very different turn: a squatting figure and a little pile of poop. A simple, immediately recognizable visual joke.

products.title: Asshole Cat
products.short_description: A cat viewed from behind with its tail raised.
products.full_description: A minimal outline of a cat facing away, tail up and rear end on display. The photographed small version uses glow-in-the-dark vinyl.

products.title: My Dog Thinks You Suck
products.short_description: Dog ears and eyes above the phrase MY DOG THINKS YOU SUCK.
products.full_description: A pair of perky dog ears and round eyes delivers the setup, then the lettering gets to the point: MY DOG THINKS YOU SUCK. A cheeky decal for dogs with strong opinions.
products.image_alt_text: My Dog Thinks You Suck cut-vinyl decal

products.title: My Bird Thinks You Suck
products.short_description: A cartoon bird face above MY BIRD THINKS YOU SUCK.
products.full_description: A little bird's head, beak, and expressive eye sit above the words MY BIRD THINKS YOU SUCK. For bird people who know their pets are absolutely judging everyone.
products.image_alt_text: My Bird Thinks You Suck cut-vinyl decal

products.title: Fuck Off Street Sign
products.short_description: A black-and-white directional street sign reading FUCK OFF.
products.full_description: Styled like a rectangular road sign, this decal points decisively to the right with a white arrow and the words FUCK OFF. A different design from the plain text version.
products.image_alt_text: Fuck Off Street Sign cut-vinyl decal

products.title: Magical As Fuck Sticker Sheet
products.short_description: A pastel unicorn-themed sticker sheet with holographic star sparkle.
products.full_description: A colorful sheet of separate stickers featuring unicorns, rainbows, stars, butterflies, and gloriously blunt messages including MAGICAL AS FUCK. The photographed sheet has a holographic stars finish.
products.image_alt_text: Magical As Fuck Sticker Sheet sticker sheet

products.title: Hotdog Slut
products.short_description: A glossy hot-dog-themed sticker with cheeky lettering.

products.title: Creampie Whore
products.short_description: A whipped-cream pie graphic with bold overlapping words.

products.title: Fuck You So Much Heart
products.short_description: A pastel layered heart reading FUCK YOU SO MUCH.

products.title: Go Fuck Yourself Retro

products.title: CUNT (Multicolor Lettering)
products.short_description: CUNT in big teal, pink, and purple letters.
products.full_description: Oversized block lettering spells CUNT in a bright mix of teal, pink, and purple. Simple, loud, and unapologetic in an individual printed sticker.

products.title: Magical As Fuck Unicorn
products.short_description: A pastel rainbow unicorn sticker reading MAGICAL AS FUCK.
products.full_description: A dreamy unicorn with a rainbow mane sits against a pastel, sparkly background, paired with the words MAGICAL AS FUCK. The photographed die-cut sticker has a holographic finish.

products.title: Zombie Attack Sticker Sheet
products.short_description: A horror sticker sheet full of cartoon zombies and gore details.
products.full_description: A sheet of separate horror-themed stickers with grinning zombies, a brain, a cleaver, blood splatters, and other delightfully gruesome details. The photographed version has a matte finish.
products.image_alt_text: Zombie Attack Sticker Sheet sticker sheet

products.title: Sex, Drugs & Rock 'n' Roll Sticker Sheet
products.short_description: A party-and-rock themed sticker sheet with many small illustrations.
products.full_description: An assortment of small printed stickers featuring drums, guitars, music notes, speakers, pills, leaves, beer mugs, and other adults-only party imagery. The header reads SEX, DRUGS, & ROCK 'N' ROLL.
products.image_alt_text: Sex, Drugs & Rock 'n' Roll Sticker Sheet sticker sheet

products.title: Emoji Tongue
products.short_description: A small round magnet with a cartoon mouth sticking out its tongue.
products.full_description: A cheeky close-up of a cartoon mouth with an oversized tongue. This small round magnet is an easy visual punchline.

products.title: Fuck Off Rainbow
products.short_description: A small round magnet with a rainbow and FUCK OFF lettering.

products.title: Go Fuck Yourself Retro
products.short_description: A small round magnet with retro GO FUCK YOURSELF typography.
products.full_description: The retro striped badge design turns GO FUCK YOURSELF into a cheerful-looking piece of refrigerator commentary. A small round magnet with white script and vintage-style colors.

products.title: Eggplant Emoji
products.short_description: A purple eggplant emoji with a green stem on a round magnet.
products.full_description: A bright purple eggplant with a green leafy top, printed on a small round magnet. Subtlety was never the point.

products.title: Fuck You So Much Heart

products.full_description: Candy-colored teal, pink, and lavender hearts surround the phrase FUCK YOU SO MUCH. A small round magnet pairing sweet graphics with a very different sentiment.

products.title: Emoji Peach
